title: CasPINS: An Integrated Web-Based Platform for CRISPR/TALEN gRNA Design, Primer Generation, and Indel Decomposition Analysis
description: CasPINS (Cas-Primer-Indel Suite) v2.0 is an open-source, unified platform that integrates the complete genome editing computational workflow — gRNA design, TALEN design, primer engineering, and indel decomposition analysis — into a single interactive web application built with Streamlit. It supports 90+ species, 14 CRISPR-Cas variants, six editing modes (including CRISPRa and CRISPRi), Ensembl/NCBI database integration, and NNLS-based Sanger trace decomposition with R² quality reporting. This version accompanies the manuscript revision submitted to Bioinformatics Advances (BIOADV-2026-089-R1).

notes: Version 2.0.0-rc1 corresponds to the R1 revision of manuscript BIOADV-2026-089 submitted to Bioinformatics Advances. Changes from v1.0.0 include: species/assembly validation, CRISPRa/CRISPRi editing modes, R-squared correction toggle for indel analysis, structured run logging, T2T-CHM13v2.0 and HG002 genome assemblies, session-state persistence across GUI tabs, updated DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE, and removal of obsolete artefacts.
